subject: general
question: Which of the following systems is used to transmit engine torque to the driving wheels to drive a vehicle on the road?
solution:
The correct answer is __Transmission system**(3)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Transmission system__ is used to transmit engine torque to the driving wheels of a vehicle.
 
• The system transfers power from the engine to the wheels, making the vehicle move.
 
• It includes components such as the clutch, gearbox, propeller shaft, and differential.
 
• The transmission system ensures proper power distribution to the wheels, even on turns or uneven roads.
 
• It also allows for speed and torque adjustments, enabling smooth vehicle operation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Four Bar Chain Mechanism:**
 
 
• It is a basic kinematic chain used in mechanical linkages.
 
• It is not related to the transmission of torque to vehicle wheels.
 
 
 
• **Steering System:**
 
 
• It is responsible for controlling the direction of the vehicle.
 
• It does not transmit engine power to the wheels.
 
 
 
• **Differential Gear Mechanism:**
 
 
• It is part of the transmission system, allowing wheels to rotate at different speeds.
 
• However, it does not transmit power directly from the engine to the wheels.
